g.text: LED driver is in AON; the relay contact sources EN only from the converter VIN.

g.desc: LED driver is in AON; the relay contact sources EN only from the converter VIN.

g.text: VIN=0 therefore cannot receive an AON logic HIGH. 22k holds EN LOW with relay open.
